The site is municipally addressed as 2980 King Street East and is located on the northwest
intersection of Regional Roads King Street East and Fairway Road North.
The surrounding neighborhood along the King Street corridor is mostly arterial commercial
uses.
Hotels Doubletree by Hilton and Courtyard by Marriott are in close proximity to the subject lands.
Access to the Conestoga Parkway is to the west of the site. Community amenities including Howard
Robertson School and the Centerville Chicopee Community Center are within walking distance.
On the next slide I will discuss the proposed concept.
The site is proposed to be redeveloped with a mixed-use building containing a six-story podium
with ground floor commercial units and a tower of 32 stories in height and containing 436 dwelling
units. A total of 339 vehicle spaces and 292 bicycle spaces are provided. Vehicle access for
structured parking is proposed from King Street East in the location of the existing access.
Access for underground parking would be from Fairway Road North.
An outdoor amenity area is proposed on top of the podium.
On the next slide I will briefly discuss comments received from the Region of Waterloo.
As part of the submission requirements for this application, the applicant prepared an
aeronautical assessment for the Region of Waterloo to review as it pertains to the regional airport.
The Region does not support land use designation changes that are incompatible with airport
operations. Therefore the maximum building height that the Region is supportive of
will result in a loss of approximately five stories of building height from the proposed 32-story tower.
This loss would change the figures for unit count, parking, etc. as the applicant would need to account for the loss in floor area.
The applicant is aware of the required reduction in height and can speak further to this matter.
Planning staff have applied a height restriction in the draft zoning bylaw as per the regional comments.
As we move to the next slide I will speak about the current opportunity with this application.
the opportunity to facilitate redevelopment of an underutilized commercial site while replacing commercial space on site,
the opportunity to add approximately 400 dwelling units within an urban corridor that contains existing services and access to community amenities,
and to foster an efficient use of land and add visual interest to the city skyline in this area.
Moving now to the next slide, I will summarize the details of the Official Plan Amendment
and Zoning Bylaw Amendment request.
To add a specific policy area to the Official Plan to allow an increase in floor space ratio
and building height to facilitate the redevelopment.
To establish a holding provision in the Zoning Bylaw to ensure a detailed noise study is
completed and implemented and to establish a site-specific provision in the Zoning By-law
for reduced yard setback, increased building height and floor space ratio, a reduction in
required parking, an increase in bicycle parking, and to prohibit geothermal energy systems.

and are consistent with provincial, regional, and the City's planning policies.
